**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or opportunity is.

A clear description of what you want to happen (e.g. support for a new IRS Schedule C line, international VAT/GST deduction rules, or a new accounting export format).

**Tax Code / Statutory Reference (if applicable)**
Relevant tax statute, regulation, or IRS publication.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative approaches or workarounds considered.
